row.evidence: Litmus SAML SSO is "available exclusively to Litmus Enterprise customers" and "New user seat creation is not supported"; the Validity knowledge base returns no results for "scim".
row.notes: Status unchanged (none), now at medium confidence by absence. Litmus is now part of Validity Engage: www.litmus.com/pricing redirects to a contact-sales form, so the June Core $500/mo price (and the eliminated Basic/Plus tiers) has no first-party source and was dropped. SAML SSO is Enterprise-only and set up by the Account Holder; users must be added manually (no JIT). Okta OIN app is SWA only; Entra gallery app is SSO only.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: Contact Sales (no public pricing; pricing page redirects to a Validity Engage contact form)
plans.notes: No public tier table: www.litmus.com/pricing redirects to /contact-sales. SAML SSO is exclusive to Litmus Enterprise; other plan names are referenced in help docs ("All other plans") but not listed.

limitations.text: Validity knowledge base returns no results for "scim"; SAML SSO cannot create users (no JIT), so users must be added manually in Litmus first.

scim.notes: No SCIM documented anywhere searched; left null (none by absence).

user_api.notes: Knowledge-base search for "litmus api" returns only Personalize content feeds and ESP sync articles; no user-management API found.

okta.notes: OIN Litmus app ticks SWA only (last updated Jun 5 2014). Litmus documents Okta SAML via a custom SAML 2.0 app integration.

entra.notes: Gallery app for SAML SSO; test users are created manually in Litmus.

google.notes: No Google Workspace SAML or provisioning guide found; Litmus lists Okta, OneLogin, Entra and generic IdPs.

onelogin.notes: Litmus documents OneLogin SAML; no user creation via SSO.

jumpcloud.notes: Not found in the JumpCloud support sitemap.
